messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — I opened a PR to clarify EU/APAC availability and the data residency footnote. Can folks eyeball the legal phrasing and the SDK region header example? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :wave:

Evan Chu: Thanks Maya. Saw the PR — small thing: the link to the APAC region page 404s (looks like the slug changed). Also the Node snippet uses `region: 'eu'` but our SDK expects `region: 'eu-west'` in the new headers example.

Lina Gómez: Re: legal phrasing — we should avoid "stored in" vs "processed in" distinction that confuses customers. Suggest: "Data may be processed and temporarily cached in the selected region. Long-term storage of customer data is subject to plan and residency options; contact sales for guarantees." I'll paste a one-line replacement in a sec.

Maya Patel: Lina that wording looks good. Can you drop the exact one-liner we should use so I can swap it in?

Lina Gómez: Use this exact sentence: "Requests are routed to the selected region for processing; long-term data retention and residency guarantees are available on Dedicated and Private plans — see the Residency Options section."

Evan Chu: For the SDK snippet, here's a minimal Node example we should include in the snippet block (so it matches runtime):

```
const Redwood = require('@redwood-inference/sdk');
const client = new Redwood.Client({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY, region: 'eu-west-1' });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-mini', prompt: 'Hello' });
console.log(res.text);
```

Evan Chu: Note `eu-west-1` is the canonical identifier we publish in the region table. Also add a footnote: "Region identifiers are stable and used in SDK/CLI configs."

Maya Patel: Good catch on the slug — Sam, did the APAC page ref change in the site rewrite?

Sam R.: Yep — the new path is /regions/apac-1 (old was /region/apac). I'll push a tiny patch to the PR to update the link. Also added the SDK snippet from Evan and Lina's sentence. CI preview: https://deploy-preview-842--docs.redwood.ai/regions/eu-apac-availability :white_check_mark:

docs-bot: PR #842 updated by Sam R. — branch: docs/region-clarify — status: deploy-preview-ready

Maya Patel: Awesome, thank you. Two remaining asks before I merge: (1) legal to give final sign-off on "residency guarantees" phrase, (2) QA to confirm sample builds in Node + Python.

Lina Gómez: Legal is OK with the phrasing as long as we link to the Enterprise residency page. Added link: https://redwood.ai/enterprise/residency.

Evan Chu: I'll run the sample build in the Python SDK and report back by EOD. Python snippet we can mirror: 

```
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('RW_API_KEY'), region='eu-west-1')
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-mini', prompt='Hi')
print(resp.text)
```

Sam R.: Tests run green on preview, small CSS tweak for table overflow left. Pushed that too.

Maya Patel: Great — once Evan confirms the Python snippet and legal link is in, I'll merge. Thanks everyone! :pray:
